title: •Aurra Sing
caption: •Aurra Sing (V)
game_text: During opponent’s activate phase, may relocate Aurra to same site as a Jedi. Once per game, during your move phase, may fire her weapon at a Jedi; hit target is lost. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: *Bounty hunter*. Former student of the Force. After failing her Jedi training, Aurra became known for hunting down and killing Jedi Knights.

notes: Unique. Stats POWER 4 / ABILITY 4 / FORCE-SENSITIVE (label only); deploy 4 / forfeit 3 (the wiki stub has deploy=3 and no forfeit — wrong; the slip prints 4 above 3, as do the printed card and the VB5 reissue). Icon column: warrior only (blue box, blaster). Alien (Tatooine grey alien frame). Margin credits: left two lines 'Original concept' / 'by Sam Tashima'; the RIGHT margin credit is split around the warrior icon box into two two-line blocks — lower block 'North' / 'Dakota', upper block 'States' / '2006' (reads bottom-to-top 'North Dakota States 2006') — recorded as margin_right (lower block) + margin_right_2 (upper block, a NEW field: the renderer needs to place it above the icon). The VB5 reissue credits 'North Dakota States 2005'; the Dec 2006 sheet prints 2006 — transcribed as printed. Curly apostrophe in opponent’s. Lore: 'Bounty hunter.' printed bold on the scan (period kept outside the bold markup as in earlier runs); comma after 'training' kept from the wiki (not clearly legible at 350 px). Copyright line read off the scan: '© 2001 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2001 DECIPHER INC.'. Base scan 350 px only. Modern: VB5-D-aurrasing-pre.gif (350 px; an 'ai' alternate also exists). V12-D-aurrasingwithblasterrifle.gif is a different card, not used.
